nodes.title: Implementation of a highly reliable multiplexed fiber optic rotary transmission system for aerospace applications
nodes.venue: Sixth International Conference on Optoelectronic Information and Communication Technology (ICOCT 2026)
nodes.venue_abbr: Sixth International Conference on Optoelectronic Information and Communication Technology (ICOCT 2026)
nodes.summary: 研究面向连续旋转航天光学载荷的多通道数据下传。采用波分复用与分解复用、旋转连接器和高速光电转换模块，并与相机及数管单元联试。摘要报告：转台角速度为50°/s时，支持三个通道、每通道2 Gbps传输，误码率优于10^(-12)，各通道具备冷备份。
